title: सप्तचत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Abhimanyu pierces Karna through the ear with arrows and cuts his banner and his charioteer. Drona remarks that the boy wears an armour taught to his father and that his youth makes him all the more dangerous.
summary.kn: ಅಭಿಮನ್ಯು ಬಾಣಗಳಿಂದ ಕರ್ಣನ ಕಿವಿಯನ್ನು ಭೇದಿಸಿ ಅವನ ಧ್ವಜ, ಸಾರಥಿಯನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ತಂದೆಗೆ ತಾನು ಕಲಿಸಿದ ಕವಚವಿದ್ಯೆ ಇವನಿಗೂ ತಿಳಿದಿದೆಯೆಂದು ದ್ರೋಣ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಯೌವನ ಅವನನ್ನು ಇನ್ನಷ್ಟು ಅಪಾಯಕರನನ್ನಾಗಿಸಿದೆ.
summary.hi: अभिमन्यु बाणों से कर्ण का कान बींधता है और उसका ध्वज तथा सारथी काट देता है। द्रोण कहते हैं कि उसके पिता को सिखाया कवच-ज्ञान उसे भी आता है और यौवन उसे और खतरनाक बनाता है।
summary.te: అభిమన్యుడు బాణాలతో కర్ణుని చెవిని గుచ్చి అతని ధ్వజాన్ని, సారథిని ఛేదిస్తాడు. తండ్రికి నేర్పిన కవచవిద్య ఇతనికీ తెలుసని ద్రోణుడు అంటాడు; యౌవనం అతన్ని మరింత ప్రమాదకరం చేసింది.
summary.ta: அபிமன்யு அம்புகளால் கர்ணனின் காதைத் துளைத்து அவன் கொடியையும் தேரோட்டியையும் வெட்டுகிறான். தன் தந்தைக்குக் கற்பித்த கவசக் கலை இவனுக்கும் தெரியும் என்றும் இளமை அவனை மேலும் ஆபத்தாக்குகிறது என்றும் த்ரோணர் கூறுகிறார்.
summary.ml: അഭിമന്യു അമ്പുകൊണ്ട് കർണ്ണന്റെ ചെവിയിലൂടെ തുളയ്ക്കുന്നു; അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ കൊടിയും സാരഥിയും മുറിക്കുന്നു. പിതാവിനെ പഠിപ്പിച്ച കവചമാണ് ബാലൻ ധരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നതെന്നും യൗവനം അദ്ദേഹത്തെ കൂടുതൽ അപകടകാരിയാക്കുന്നുവെന്നും ദ്രോണർ അഭിപ്രായപ്പെടുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.47; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
स कर्णं कर्णिना कर्णे पुनर्विव्याध फाल्गुनिः ।
शरैः पञ्चाशता चैनमविध्यत्कोपयन्भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna's son pierced Karna again in the ear with a barbed arrow, and enraged him further by striking him with fifty more arrows.

verses.text:
प्रतिविव्याध राधेयस्तावद्भिरथ तं पुनः ।
स तैराचितसर्वाङ्गो बह्वशोभत भारत ॥

meaning.en: The son of Radha struck him back with as many, O Bharata, and with his whole body covered in arrows Abhimanyu shone greatly.

verses.text:
कर्णं चाप्यकरोत्क्रुद्धो रुधिरोत्पीडवाहिनम् ।
कर्णोऽपि विबभौ शूरः शरैश्चित्रोऽसृगाप्लुतः ॥

meaning.en: In his anger Abhimanyu made Karna too stream with blood, and the heroic Karna, streaked with arrows and drenched in blood, also shone.

verses.text:
तावुभौ शरचित्राङ्गौ रुधिरेण समुक्षितौ ।
बभूवतुर्महात्मानौ पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ ॥

meaning.en: Both great-souled men, their limbs marked by arrows and sprinkled with blood, looked like two flowering kimshuka trees.

verses.text:
अथ कर्णस्य सचिवान्षट्शूरांश्चित्रयोधिनः ।
साश्वसूतध्वजरथान्सौभद्रो निजघान ह ॥

meaning.en: Then Subhadra's son killed six heroic, skilful fighters who were Karna's counsellors, along with their horses, charioteers, banners and chariots.

verses.text:
अथेतरान्महेष्वासान्दशभिर्दशभिः शरैः ।
प्रत्यविध्यदसंभ्रान्तस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Unflustered, he then struck the other great archers back with ten arrows each, and it seemed a marvel.

verses.text:
मागधस्य पुनः पुत्रं हत्वा षड्भिरजिह्मगैः ।
साश्वं ससूतं तरुणमश्वकेतुमपातयत् ॥

meaning.en: He then killed the son of the Magadha king with six straight arrows, and brought down the young Ashvaketu with his horses and charioteer.

verses.text:
मार्तिकावतकं भोजं ततः कुञ्जरकेतनम् ।
क्षुरप्रेण समुन्मथ्य ननाद विसृजञ्शरान् ॥

meaning.en: With a razor-headed arrow he struck down the Bhoja Martikavataka, whose banner bore an elephant, and roared as he loosed his arrows.

verses.text:
तस्य दौःशासनिर्विद्ध्वा चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान् ।
सूतमेकेन विव्याध दशभिश्चार्जुनात्मजम् ॥

meaning.en: Duhshasana's son pierced his four horses with four arrows, his charioteer with one, and Arjuna's son with ten.

verses.text:
ततो दौःशासनिं कार्ष्णिर्विद्ध्वा सप्तभिराशुगैः ।
संरम्भाद्रक्तनयनो वाक्यमुच्चैरथाब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Krishna's nephew then pierced Duhshasana's son with seven swift arrows and, red-eyed with fury, said loudly:

verses.text:
पिता तवाहवं त्यक्त्वा गतः कापुरुषो यथा ।
दिष्ट्या त्वमपि जानीषे योद्धुं न त्वद्य मोक्ष्यसे ॥

meaning.en: "Your father left the battle like a coward and ran. It is by luck you too know how to fight, but you will not escape today."

verses.text:
एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं कर्मारपरिमार्जितम् ।
नाराचं विससर्जास्मै तं द्रौणिस्त्रिभिराच्छिनत् ॥

meaning.en: Having said these words, he hurled at him a nalika arrow polished by a smith, but Drona's son cut it into three.

verses.text:
तस्यार्जुनिर्ध्वजं छित्त्वा शल्यं त्रिभिरताडयत् ।
तं शल्यो नवभिर्बाणैर्गार्ध्रपत्रैरताडयत् ॥

meaning.en: Abhimanyu cut down Ashvatthama's banner and struck Shalya with three arrows, and Shalya struck him back with nine vulture-feathered arrows.

verses.text:
तस्यार्जुनिर्ध्वजं छित्त्वा उभौ च पार्ष्णिसारथी ।
तं विव्याधायसैः षड्भिः सोऽपक्रामद्रथान्तरम् ॥

meaning.en: Abhimanyu cut down Shalya's banner and both his rear-guards and charioteer, and pierced him with six iron arrows, so that Shalya withdrew to another chariot.

verses.text:
शत्रुंजयं चन्द्रकेतुं मेघवेगं सुवर्चसम् ।
सूर्यभासं च पञ्चैतान्हत्वा विव्याध सौबलम् ॥

meaning.en: After killing five men, Shatrunjaya, Chandraketu, Meghavega, Suvarchas and Suryabhasa, he pierced Shakuni's son.

verses.text:
तं सौबलस्त्रिभिर्विद्ध्वा दुर्योधनमथाब्रवीत् ।
सर्व एनं प्रमथ्नीमः पुरैकैकं हिनस्ति नः ॥

meaning.en: Shakuni's son, having pierced him with three arrows, said to Duryodhana, "Let us all crush him together, or he will kill us one at a time."

verses.text:
अथाब्रवीत्तदा द्रोणं कर्णो वैकर्तनो वृषा ।
पुरा सर्वान्प्रमथ्नाति ब्रूह्यस्य वधमाशु नः ॥

meaning.en: Then Karna, son of Vikartana, the mighty one, said to Drona, "He is crushing everyone. Tell us quickly how to kill him."

verses.text:
ततो द्रोणो महेष्वासः सर्वांस्तान्प्रत्यभाषत ।
अस्ति वोऽस्यान्तरं कश्चित्कुमारस्य प्रपश्यति ॥

meaning.en: Then the great archer Drona replied to them all, "Does any of you see an opening against this boy?"

verses.text:
अन्वस्य पितरं ह्यद्य चरतः सर्वतोदिशम् ।
शीघ्रतां नरसिंहस्य पाण्डवेयस्य पश्यत ॥

meaning.en: "See the speed of that man-lion, Pandu's grandson, as he ranges in every direction after his father."

verses.text:
धनुर्मण्डलमेवास्य रथमार्गेषु दृश्यते ।
संदधानस्य विशिखाञ्शीघ्रं चैव विमुञ्चतः ॥

meaning.en: "Only the circle of his bow is seen on the chariot paths, as he fits arrows and swiftly looses them."

verses.text:
आरुजन्निव मे प्राणान्मोहयन्नपि सायकैः ।
प्रहर्षयति मा भूयः सौभद्रः परवीरहा ॥

meaning.en: "As if he were tearing out my life and bewildering me with his arrows, Subhadra's son, the slayer of enemy heroes, delights me yet again."

verses.text:
अति मा नन्दयत्येष सौभद्रो विचरन्रणे ।
अन्तरं यस्य संरब्धा न पश्यन्ति महारथाः ॥

meaning.en: "This son of Subhadra delights me greatly as he moves in battle, since even enraged great chariot-warriors find no opening in him."

verses.text:
अस्यतो लघुहस्तस्य दिशः सर्वा महेषुभिः ।
न विशेषं प्रपश्यामि रणे गाण्डीवधन्वनः ॥

meaning.en: "As that light-handed man shoots great arrows in every direction, I cannot see any difference in battle between him and Arjuna, the Gandiva archer."

verses.text:
अथ कर्णः पुनर्द्रोणमाहार्जुनिशरार्दितः ।
स्थातव्यमिति तिष्ठामि पीड्यमानोऽभिमन्युना ॥

meaning.en: Then Karna, tormented by Arjuna's son's arrows, said to Drona again, "I stay only because I must stay, though Abhimanyu is hurting me."

verses.text:
तेजस्विनः कुमारस्य शराः परमदारुणाः ।
क्षिण्वन्ति हृदयं मेऽद्य घोराः पावकतेजसः ॥

meaning.en: "The arrows of this fiery young man are most terrible, dreadful and blazing like fire, and they pierce my heart today."

verses.text:
तमाचार्योऽब्रवीत्कर्णं शनकैः प्रहसन्निव ।
अभेद्यमस्य कवचं युवा चाशुपराक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: The teacher answered Karna slowly, almost smiling, "His armour cannot be pierced, and the young man is swift in attack."

verses.text:
उपदिष्टा मया अस्य पितुः कवचधारणा ।
तामेष निखिलां वेत्ति ध्रुवं परपुरंजयः ॥

meaning.en: "I taught his father how to wear armour, and this conqueror of enemy cities surely knows all of it."

verses.text:
शक्यं त्वस्य धनुश्छेत्तुं ज्यां च बाणैः समाहितैः ।
अभीशवो हयाश्चैव तथोभौ पार्ष्णिसारथी ॥

meaning.en: "But with well-aimed arrows one can cut his bow and bowstring, his reins and horses, and both his rear-guards and charioteer."

verses.text:
एतत्कुरु महेष्वास राधेय यदि शक्यते ।
अथैनं विमुखीकृत्य पश्चात्प्रहरणं कुरु ॥

meaning.en: "Do this, great archer, son of Radha, if you can. Then, having made him turn away, strike him afterwards."

verses.text:
सधनुष्को न शक्योऽयमपि जेतुं सुरासुरैः ।
विरथं विधनुष्कं च कुरुष्वैनं यदीच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: "While he holds his bow, not even gods and demons could conquer him. If you wish, make him chariotless and bowless."

verses.text:
तदाचार्यवचः श्रुत्वा कर्णो वैकर्तनस्त्वरन् ।
अस्यतो लघुहस्तस्य पृषत्कैर्धनुराच्छिनत् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the teacher's words, Karna, son of Vikartana, hurried and cut Abhimanyu's bow with arrows as he shot, light-handed.

verses.text:
अश्वानस्यावधीद्भोजो गौतमः पार्ष्णिसारथी ।
शेषास्तु छिन्नधन्वानं शरवर्षैरवाकिरन् ॥

meaning.en: The Bhoja killed his horses, and Gautama Kripa killed his rear-guard charioteer, while the rest showered the bowless man with arrows.

verses.text:
त्वरमाणास्त्वराकाले विरथं षण्महारथाः ।
शरवर्षैरकरुणा बालमेकमवाकिरन् ॥

meaning.en: At that moment of haste, six great chariot-warriors, without pity, covered the single chariotless boy with showers of arrows.

verses.text:
स छिन्नधन्वा विरथः स्वधर्ममनुपालयन् ।
खड्गचर्मधरः श्रीमानुत्पपात विहायसम् ॥

meaning.en: With his bow cut and chariot lost, the glorious youth, keeping to his own duty, took sword and shield and leapt into the sky.

verses.text:
मार्गैः स कैशिकाद्यैश्च लाघवेन बलेन च ।
आर्जुनिर्व्यचरद्व्योम्नि भृशं वै पक्षिराडिव ॥

meaning.en: By the Kaishika and other manoeuvres, with agility and strength, Arjuna's son moved through the air like the king of birds.

verses.text:
मय्येव निपतत्येष सासिरित्यूर्ध्वदृष्टयः ।
विव्यधुस्तं महेष्वासाः समरे छिद्रदर्शिनः ॥

meaning.en: "He will fall on me, sword in hand," thought each, and looking up, the great archers watching for an opening shot at him in the fight.

verses.text:
तस्य द्रोणोऽच्छिनन्मुष्टौ खड्गं मणिमयत्सरुम् ।
राधेयो निशितैर्बाणैर्व्यधमच्चर्म चोत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Drona cut his sword, with its jewelled hilt, at the grip, and Radha's son shattered his excellent shield with sharp arrows.

verses.text:
व्यसिचर्मेषुपूर्णाङ्गः सोऽन्तरिक्षात्पुनः क्षितिम् ।
आस्थितश्चक्रमुद्यम्य द्रोणं क्रुद्धोऽभ्यधावत ॥

meaning.en: With his sword and shield gone and his body full of arrows, he came down from the air to the ground, took up a wheel, and ran angrily at Drona.

verses.text:
स चक्ररेणूज्ज्वलशोभिताङ्गो
बभावतीवोन्नतचक्रपाणिः ।
रणेऽभिमन्युः क्षणदासुभद्रः
स वासुभद्रानुकृतिं प्रकुर्वन् ॥

meaning.en: His body shining with the gleam of the wheel, Abhimanyu stood in battle with the wheel raised high in his hand, a very image of Krishna, Vasudeva's son.

verses.text:
स्रुतरुधिरकृतैकरागवक्त्रो
भ्रुकुटिपुटाकुटिलोऽतिसिंहनादः ।
प्रभुरमितबलो रणेऽभिमन्यु-
र्नृपवरमध्यगतो भृशं व्यराजत् ॥

meaning.en: His face reddened evenly with streaming blood, his brows knit in a frown, roaring like a lion, mighty Abhimanyu of immeasurable strength shone brightly in the midst of the foremost kings.
